title: Chapter 718: Someone Is Valued As A Prince
content:
Chapter 718: Someone Is Valued As A Prince

The night is getting darker. Although there is a curfew outside, Meng Tianfang is a younger brother of the Weiwei clan. He has his own talisman and can travel between the two houses unimpeded.

What's even more strange is that although the whole city is under martial law to arrest Mo, no one has come to surround Fusu's mansion.

But they didn't dare wait until dawn.

When Mengtian put it in, Fusu was discussing countermeasures with several counselors.

"What kind of person do you think Emperor Shun is?" Dong Gong and others seemed to be trying to persuade Fusu.

Fusu took a while before replying: "It's a saint."

"Exactly!"

Dong Gong said: "If Shun had not escaped the poisonous hands of his father and brothers who filled the well with earth when he was dredging the well, it would have been the mud in the well; if he had not escaped the poisonous hands of his father and brothers who had set fire to it below when he was painting the granary, then it would have been As the ashes on the ground. How to spread the blessings throughout the world and spread the law to future generations? Therefore, Emperor Shun accepted the small stick and walked away with the big stick. This is probably because he had big things in mind..."

"What does Mr. Dong mean?"

"Young master also has great ambitions. If you want to save the Qin Dynasty and save the world, you must save yourself first! It is better to leave than to wait for death!"

Because Fusu could only think of "robbing the king" as a last resort if Qin Shihuang was once again in a state of confusion, Meng Tianfang's direct military advice had been rejected by him.

So there are only two roads before you: stay or go.

Fusu was still undecided. At this time, Meng Tianfang came back and told Fusu what Meng Tian meant.

"It is still clear to Weiwei Meng that military remonstrance has no chance of winning and may even cause greater chaos. Fusu must not do such a thing."

Fusu lamented that he also understood that over the past year, his hesitation between "forbearance" and "coup" turned a good hand into a bad situation. At this point, it is no longer possible for everyone to be unscathed, someone must make sacrifices!

Meng Tian is aware, and he will take over all the sins of "colluding with Fusu"! But Meng Yi, who went to report him "out of justice", and the entire Meng family, were able to survive because of this.

"If Meng Weiwei can do this, why can't Fusu do this?"

Fusu stood up resolutely: "Fusu has been established recently and has two sons. In order to protect them, and to ensure that the world still recognizes my name of loyalty, benevolence, and filial piety, and to preserve the unity of the Qin Dynasty, I can sacrifice myself!"

All the subordinates knelt on the ground: "What do you want to do, Master?"

"When you enter the palace, whether you live or die, everything is at your father's discretion!"

"If the young master enters the palace, everything will be over!\

,"Meng Tian was furious. Like Dong Gong and others, he urged Fu Su not to give up hope and wait for an opportunity to leave Xianyang in order to make a comeback.

Fusu was very pessimistic about this: "Not to mention that Guanzhong was heavily guarded. Even Lord Shang could not escape smoothly, let alone how far away he was. Even if I leave by chance, even though the world is big, there are probably only those who can accept Fusu. Is he the Marquis of Changnan?"

He smiled miserably and said: "The Marquis of Changnan guaranteed in his secret letter that he would be willing to rely on me if anything happens in the court. But my departure not only confirmed the court's conviction that Fusu had colluded with Mo to assassinate his father, he was also guilty of treason. It will make my father sad, and it will also implicate the Marquis of Changnan."

"If you accept me, Lingnan will turn against the imperial court, and the still unified world will immediately be divided, and wars and conquests will follow. In that case, Fusu will become a temptation that triggers war. Star? A son fights his father, a minister fights a king. Can Hei Fu and I do this? Who will support it? "

"Therefore, I would rather die than be a sinner who brings trouble to the world!"

This was probably the last bit of sanity Fusu maintained during this long night after being frightened and confused. After being confused for a long time, he finally returned to his true nature.

Dong Gong, Meng Tianfang, Shao Ping and others looked up in disbelief: "What about the young master's ideals? What about the new policy of the court that we deduced? Is it just like this?"

Restoring rituals and music, enfeoffing overseas territories, stopping wars, easing corvee and paying little in taxes, and creating the same style of society. These are their dreams that they often discuss heatedly late into the night...

Fusu sighed and helped everyone up one by one: "You all call me 'eldest son Fusu'. Let me ask you, among these titles, which one is more important, the eldest son or Fusu?"

Everyone looked at each other, but Fusu said: "The eldest son is more important. If I escape, once I step out of Xianyang, I will no longer be the eldest son, only Fusu will be left. And the one you want to follow is the eldest son of benevolence and filial piety." Young Master, not Fusu, the rebellious minister and traitor!"

There is no point in talking anymore, Fusu has made up his mind. Seeing these passionate words, everyone finally stopped trying to persuade him. Even the most staunch Meng Tianfang also lowered his head and said nothing. He shook his head and bowed to everyone.

"Fusu cannot repay the kindness of the second and third sons for their help, so let's just say goodbye! I will tie myself up and go to Xianyang Palace to wait until dawn to apologize to my father!"

"Actually, even if I enter the palace, my father will not necessarily kill me. At worst, he will imprison me, but he will also treat my son well. If you don't see me, the son of Lord Chang'an, Ying, will live well..."

Fusu said this with a smile, but he was not very confident. He didn't know his father at all, so he just shook his head and turned to leave.

But before Fusu could step over the threshold, someone quickly came from behind and hit Fusu hard on the back of the head!

Fusu was unprepared, and the world was spinning. Before he could turn around to see who did it, he rolled his eyes and fainted to the ground.

Someone helped him. Before he lost consciousness, the last sound Fusu heard in his ears was Shaoping's horrified cry...

"Meng Tianfang, you!"

…

"Meng Tianfang, are you betraying the young master?"

Shaoping was so frightened that he drew his sword. If Dong Gong hadn't stopped him, he would have attacked Meng Tianfang.

"Young Master is fine, he just fainted."

Meng Tianfang tried Fusu's breathing, gently hugged Fusu and placed him on the couch. His movements were gentle and respectful, then he took three steps back and bowed three times!

"Young master is wrong. Even if you are no longer the eldest master, Meng Tianfang will still follow Fusu to the end!"

He turned around and said solemnly: "If the king is worried, the minister will be humiliated, and if the king is humiliated, the minister will die. Sooner or later, we have all been loyal to the young master and regard him as the master. How can we sit back and watch the young master die?"

"So you knocked the young master unconscious and wanted to kidnap him and leave Xianyang?"

Shao Ping put down his sword. He understood Meng Tianfang's plan and looked at Dong Gong with some hesitation.

Dong Gong stroked his beard and said: "My lord often makes some wrong decisions. A wise man is like Duke Wen of Jin, Chong'er. When he arrived in Qi, Duke Huan of Qi generously offered gifts to his wife, and gave her a wife with twenty horses. Chong'er felt that his life was peaceful and no longer what it used to be. In exile, he decided to live in Qi State and not return to Jin Dynasty. In the end, Zhao Shui and the criminal fox conspired under the mulberry tree to get Chong'er drunk and took him away from Qi State."

"Although Chong'er was furious afterwards, without this trip, there would be no Jin Wen hegemony. Tian Fang's move today has the same purpose but a different approach, and it is also an act of loyalty!"

Meng Tian laughed loudly: "Dong Gong still understands the truth."

Shaoping still hesitated: "But the young master is right. Leaving Xianyang at this time to join the Marquis of Changnan will make the world think that the young master is plotting to kill criminals, and it will even cause war..."

Meng Tian said angrily: "Could it be that if the young master commits suicide and dies in Xianyang Palace, the world will not be in chaos? The prophecy that the First Emperor will be divided after his death has spread to Guanzhong, and the young master is destined to prevent this prophecy. People are the hope of all people in the world!"

Dong Gong echoed: "However, Shen Sheng died inside and Chong'er was safe outside. Xian Gong sent eunuchs to kill Chong'er. This was his father's order. But Chong'er walked over the wall and ran to Di. People in the world only thought that Xian Gong was unkind. But I don’t think Chong’er is unfilial…”

"If you enter the palace and are captured, killed or imprisoned, everything will be over. Now the Meng Guards are willing to open one side of the net, and we will take the young master away and rush south to Changnan Hou's army. One day, we may be able to repeat the story of Jin Wen!"

Shaoping finally nodded and reached a consensus. They asked the traditional Chinese medicine doctor in the mansion for some "narcotics" invented by Chen Wujiu using marijuana, so that Fusu could sleep a little longer...

The three men have different divisions of labor. Dong Gong is the mastermind, Meng Tianfang is the military attache, and Shaoping is similar to the family leader.

Shao Ping said: "I will go and wake up the young master, his wife, and the two young masters in the mansion, and leave together."

Duke Dong caught up with him and told him: "Call Changnanhou's confidant Ji Ying and go to Changnanhou's mansion to pick up all Changnanhou's family members! If they are used as hostages, Changnanhou will throw a rat weapon into his arms." Or it will happen again!"

"promise!"

After Shaoping left, Meng Tianfang was also leaving.

Meng Tianfang decided to go out of the city to Afang to make preparations. Once Fusu and others successfully left the city, he mobilized the guards of Afang Palace and dismissed the prisoners, allowing them to scatter and create chaos.

Then, while the lieutenant and guard were arresting the prisoners, the group went westward and entered Hanzhong via Ziwu Road.

Try to go to Jianghan and Lingnan again!

Watching the two of them go away, Mr. Dong breathed a sigh of relief, raised his head, looked at the bright moon that was completely obscured by dark clouds and said:

"The sky has been strange recently. I don't know how long your Majesty will live. We don't need to fight with the imperial court. As long as the mountains collapse, the eldest son will still be the eldest son!"

"With the help of the Marquis of Changnan from the outside, and the support from the Meng clan from the inside, until then, the position of the second emperor will still belong to the young master. Even if he blames us and tries to kill us, I will still be willing to do so!"

…

"Madam, everything is ready and ready to go at any time!"

On the eve of the rooster's crow, Ji Ying and Sang Mu, who sneaked back to the house, reported to Ye Zijin that the matter was confidential. The Heihu family had a wife, a niece and two sons, and only needed to load a car, plus two of the most loyal slaves. , and ten retainers as escorts, which is the number of entourages that an ordinary wealthy family would have when traveling.

"If the Weiwei army can really let him go, he might be able to sneak into Prince Fusu's car and leave Xianyang."

Ye Zijin looked at the dark sky. Although his face was calm, he was still worried because the chance of success was too small.

Even though she was smart, she never expected that in just a few days, Fusu would be able to play out such a bad situation with a handful of good cards in his hand.

"I finally understand why my beloved has been ambiguous with Young Master Fusu for the past ten years. He somewhat acknowledges his ambitions and ideas, but does not directly declare his attachment to him."

She sighed secretly: "Because this young master is full of ambition and pride, but he has no knowledge of others. He can't even manage his subordinates well..."

Mo Zhe deviated from his plan and carried out the assassination rashly. The most ridiculous thing is that several of Fusu's clever subordinates dared to disobey their master's will, knocked him unconscious and forcibly took him away from Xianyang.

From the perspective of a counselor, there is nothing wrong with this: A man who counts scholars takes his son as his life, and the son will not leave the country quickly, make achievements, and repay his servants. Instead, he will be reluctant to be captured and steal for the son to shame...

But Ye Zijin sneered, thinking that they did this just because Fusu might be able to survive if he went to the palace to plead guilty, but the counselors in his mansion, those who "led Fusu into evil", Qin Shihuang ordered them all to be killed. Gotta die!

Fusu was willing to sit back and wait for death, but they didn't want to, so they took this ridiculous action.

But okay, this chaos is the only chance Ye Zijin can think of to escape! Because once Fusu runs south, Heifu will be even more confused...

Unless he can really cut off Fusu's head and send it back.

"I feel sad for Fusu." Ye Zijin thought.

"But what's even more sad is that those who have pinned all their hopes on Fusu, the savior you are looking forward to, he is resolute and brave, a believer and a warrior, and a benevolent person. Unfortunately, he does not have the ability to match his reputation. …”

Young Master Fusu, he is a noble son, but without the prefix of eldest son, only Fusu is left, which is not as good as a man, and cannot correct three people.

But Heifu was different. He was once Heifu of the head of Guizhou, Heifu of the pavilion, Heifu of the village... Heifu of the Marquis of Changnan.

These prefixed titles can indeed bring a certain amount of power, but the key lies in Heifu and his abilities!

Ye Zijin has full confidence in her husband. Although this unpredictable situation has completely deviated from his imagination, Heihu can always adapt to the situation and survive in danger!

She didn't know that Heifu just had another problem created by the author...

When the signal came from outside and he was about to board the bus, Ye Zijin called Ji Ying and said a word to him.

"You can tell him about the text I added to your letter when you are safely out of the way."

"But if we can't escape and die in Xianyang City or on the way, then let this matter rot in our stomachs!"

She was very familiar with her husband's handwriting, but in Heifu's letter, Ye added only one sentence:

"The ancients said that three people make a tiger, and Zeng Zi kills people. Today, Hei Fu is not as wise as Zeng Shen, and His Majesty's loyal ministers are not as trustworthy as Zeng Shen's mother. There are more than three people who doubt Hei Fu. Hei Fu may have been living outside for a long time, and someone If you slander me, Your Majesty will be thrown into a tree."

Warlock Lu Ao's self-destruction and rumors of "the one who killed Qin was black" were flying all over the sky. This was something Heifu never expected. He originally just wanted to vaccinate Fusu in advance to make plans for the future.

Mrs. Ye then added some "worries" for him, which would make Hei Fu's words more credible. At that time, she hoped that Fusu could help Hei Fu. Even if it didn't work, he could help protect the whole family who were held hostage in Xianyang. …

Heifu is thousands of miles away, so Ye can only adapt to circumstances.

Unexpectedly, Fusu fell rapidly and was already at the point where he was going to join Heifu.

Thinking about it afterwards, more of this sentence and less of this sentence have nothing to do with the situation.

However, a strange combination of circumstances strengthened the determination of Fusu's subordinates to go and join Heifu, which can be regarded as a mistake.

Ji Ying accepted the promise, the gate opened, and the carriages and horses moved forward. The eyeliner who had been monitoring the Wei Mansion suddenly woke up and began to step forward to stop him.

Unfortunately, in order to arrest the assassin who was planning the assassination, they mobilized their manpower. They were caught off guard and were repulsed by the soldiers sent by the Fusu Mansion.

The carriages and horses of Heifu's family were able to successfully enter the street and join Young Master Fusu's team!

Fusu is still in a coma, and his three subordinates are controlling everything.

Ye Zijin opened the car curtain and said to Ji Ying who was driving the car himself: "Uncle Ji, after you leave Xianyang, don't go with Master Fusu on the same road, stay away from him!"

Fusu has too many men and horses, plus various personal guards, there are more than a hundred people. Like a bright light in the dark night, he will attract all the pursuers!

"Let him go to Ziwu Road, and we will use the forged talisman to go west to Wugong, enter Hanzhong from Baoxie Road, and then go to Bashu!"

That was the route Ji Ying took, and Heifu had some "connections" there.

After saying that, Mrs. Ye closed the car curtain and hugged the two children tightly.

This is destined to be a night full of chaos!

Undercurrents are surging, but Xianyang Palace is like a huge boulder in the sea, unmoving, as if His Majesty the Emperor doesn't care about what is happening and has never interfered...

But on the towering high platform, there is also a person, in the cold wind, hanging his disabled hand, staring at every move of each force, with a clear insight!

Looking at the lights gradually lighting up in the city, Zhao Gao licked his lips and smiled.

"Your Majesty is seriously ill and the eldest son is running away. What does this mean?"
